title: Three-body potentials with large triplet lists
purpose: Exercises the dynamic storage of the three-body module of the `epsr` engine [@soper1996,@soper2005,@epsrmanual] with long distance ranges, so that triplet and neighbour lists outgrow their initial allocations.
system: The EPSR-test system: a liquid mixture of 200 dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO, (CH3)2SO) and 400 water molecules (DMSO mole fraction 1/3; 3200 atoms) at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å (atomic number density 0.0881 atoms/Å³). DMSO uses EPSR's Lennard-Jones + Coulomb reference potential with methyl rotational groups; water uses SPC/E Lennard-Jones and charge parameters [@berendsen1987] with EPSR's flexible intramolecular geometry (O-H 0.976 Å). The empirical potential is refined against three neutron diffraction data sets of deuterated DMSO in D2O, in null-scattering H2O/D2O and in H2O (ISIS SANDALS runs SLS03863, SLS03871, SLS03850), the isotope-substitution approach of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. A `tb A1 A2 A3 amp awidth rwidth rmax12 rmax32 s12 s23 s13 ang1 amp1 ...` line in the `.pcof` adds an angular energy `amp*ampN*0.5*((cos theta - cosN)/awidth)²` to every triplet A1-A2-A3 (A2 the centre) within the distance limits, for the requested angle N closest to theta; the flags select same or different molecules. Groups, all atoms on different molecules: water O1···O1···O1 (6 Å ranges; 109.5° and 70°), H1···O1···O1 (5/3 Å, 100°) and DMSO-centred O1···S···O1 (4 Å, 90°).
inputs: EPSR-test with the three `tb` lines appended to the `.pcof`; the `.EPSR.inp` is unchanged. `commands.txt`: `epsr 200DMSO400Water.EPSR.inp`, `repeat 2`.
verification: More than 10000 triplets in a group (the Fortran reallocates `tripletlist`) and more than 4 triplet neighbours per molecule (reallocation of `threebneighbmol`), DMSO-centred triplets with water neighbours. The triplet energies of all three groups enter `fmolec1`, every move decision of `en_change` and the three-body pressure in `press`; the `tb` lines are rewritten and re-read in pass 2.
notes: Reproduced: `read_pcof` stores cosines and width 1.0, but `save_files_others` re-reads the `tb` symbol at the end of each iteration and stores angles and width in radians, so later iterations use different triplet energies.
